text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: How odd. I hypothesized that you would be able to get at least one…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: No, they say failure is the mother of success. This is but the first step of many.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: So, let's move on to experimenting with my newest concoction! This time, you'll enter a kind of hypnotic state.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Agh! I forgot it in the laboratory… That's fine, we can just go back!
